hotel_name: Mohan Vilaas By Royal Pepper Hotel And Resorts

positive_snippets:
Recently i hosted my cousin wedding at Mohan Villas Resort on the 29th & 30th of November, and the experience was truly wonderful. Mukesh ji, Sunil ji and Jolly ji were extremely supportive throughout both days. The ground floor staff was also very caring and cooperative — they handled everything smoothly without giving us any stress.

The decoration was beautiful, and the food was absolutely delicious. The location is great as well, with a spacious open area that makes the overall experience and photos even better.

Overall, it was a very smooth and memorable celebration. Highly recommended for weddings and family functions!

The place was fine, good even with ample space for parking, but reaching there was a headache. Its in northern most part of Delhi and the traffic we had to face drained out all the excitement we had for wedding. But good food raised our spirits. Overall a good place
